    "Autofill can be inconsistent on some complex websites.",
    "User interface might feel less polished compared to some competitors.",
    "Occasional need to re-login to the browser extension."

  "overall_experience": "This freelancer likely found Bitwarden to be an invaluable and highly cost-effective tool for managing all their digital credentials and sensitive information. The robust features, cross-device accessibility, and strong security provided significant peace of mind, allowing them to maintain unique, complex passwords without hassle. While the UI might not be the sleekest and autofill occasionally requires manual intervention, the overall reliability and value made it an essential part of their workflow for over two years."
